contentText: Fuel distribution in Iran’s capital was “temporarily interrupted” after strikes on oil depots in and around the city, Tehran Governor Johammad Sadegh Motamedian told the state news agency on Sunday. Iran’s Revolutionary Guards earlier said the country could sustain an “intense war” with the US and Israel for at least six months. FRANCE24 corresdpondent Noga Tarnopolsky reports the latest from Jerusalem.
